title: Aqara Vibration Sensor False-Trip Cluster
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aqara:device device_class=vibration
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as vibration_events by device _time
| where vibration_events>10
| sort - vibration_events
description: Uses Aqara vibration sensors telemetry to monitor bursts of vibration events inside short windows in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for false alarms or noisy placements that need cleanup, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Aqara vibration sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals bursts of vibration events inside short windows so you can spot false alarms or noisy placements that need cleanup before it becomes annoying.
